book.totem.manual.getting_started.title: Totem Starter Guide
book.totem.manual.getting_started.page.1:
GETTING STARTED

TotemCore gives you this starter guide the first time you join. Other Totem modules do not create separate manuals; acquired chapters are recorded into this same book.
book.totem.manual.getting_started.page.2:
CHAPTER SOURCES 1/2

Hold a Totem Manual or plain book and use the source block:

Alchemy: Brewing Stand, Cauldron / Water Cauldron, Alchemy Cauldron
Remnant: Smithing Table
Automata: any Copper Chest
Enchanting: Enchanting Table
book.totem.manual.getting_started.page.3:
CHAPTER SOURCES 2/2

Excavation: Crafting Table
Locksmith: Chest, Trapped Chest, Barrel
Vanilla Tweaks: Lectern
Villagers: Composter

Nexus does not use a block chapter source.
book.totem.manual.getting_started.page.4:
NO MANUAL YET

A plain book also works on any source block listed above. Core creates the Totem Manual, records the starter chapter first, then adds that module's chapter.
book.totem.manual.getting_started.page.5:
READING & UPDATES

All acquired chapters stay in one manual; use Contents to jump between them. Core refreshes recorded chapters after module or content updates, so the manual never needs to be split.
